parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The accelerated domain name.

To specify multiple accelerated domain names, separate them with commas (,). If you do not set this parameter, data for all your accelerated domain names is queried.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity for the query. Unit: seconds.

Valid values are 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day). The supported value varies based on the maximum time range per query. For more information, see the supported time granularities in the **Usage notes**.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description:
The English name of the carrier.

You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation to obtain the English name. If you do not set this parameter, data for all carriers is queried.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description:
The English name of the region.

You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~207199~~) operation to obtain the English name. If you do not set this parameter, data for all regions is queried.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.
